sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in connection with Spl. G.R. Case No.42 of 2024 pending on the file of learned Additional District & Sessions Judge-cum- Special Judge, under POCSO Act, Balangir,
arising out of Agalpur P.S. Case No.70 of 2024 for commission of offence alleged under Sections 363/366/376(2)(n) of the IPC and Section 6 of the POCSO Act.
3. Learned counsel, on instruction, submits that except the present BLAPL, no other bail application of the Petitioner relating to the aforementioned P.S. case is pending in any other Court.

4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) by the learned A.D.J.-cum- Special Judge under POCSO Act, Balangir by order dated 17.07.2024 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
5. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner is in custody since 09.05.2024 and as charge sheet has already been filed on 08.07.2024, Petitioner may be released on bail.
6. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.
7. Perused the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim which is on record.

sentences.text: Considering the same and filing of charge sheet, this Court directs the Petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.

9. Additionally, it is directed that the Petitioner shall appear before the jurisdictional police station once every month on such date and time to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin till conclusion of trial.
Certification of such appearance shall be submitted to the Court in seisin.
10. It is further directed that the Petitioner shall not in any way try to intimidate the victim and/or her family member.

11. It shall be open to the prosecution as well as victim to seek variance of this order, in case there is any threat perception.
12.
Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
13. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
